environment.description: Celery worker deployed as a Kubernetes pod in namespace 'batch-workers' on EKS cluster. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy objects applied to the namespace. Worker nodes have IMDSv1 enabled (no token requirement enforced). Pod can reach any IP including 169.254.169.254. Users submit report templates via the web API which dispatches Celery tasks.

config.imds_version: v1 (no hop limit, no token required)
